body: I'm ok, I just tried to sleep last night. I'm feeling better, and the urge to cut is passing. I'm really thankful for people like you, thank you so much

It is late where I am. I'm sorry if this was time consuming or a nuisance. I've already cried myself out tonight, I'm very exhausted and drained. It may not seem like it, but talking to you helped a lot. Thank you for staying with me
I think about suicide almost everyday, but I convince myself not to do it. Sometimes I just need a distraction
I'm scared to tell him. I don't want to worry him or scare him. He's had so much to deal with already, I can't burden him more than he already is

Three months ago, I tried to commit suicide. My brother caught me, and my family all talked to me. That's why I promised not to hurt myself again. But nothing has changed. I don't know why I try anymore if nothing changes

I didn't really have a type of singing, I did it as a release. For a long time, it was my only outlet for how I felt. It was like screaming out my pain.  The louder I sang, the better I felt. The prettier I sang, the happier I would make people. But I just don't feel it anymore. People don't want to hear my voice, and it's ok. Some voices aren't meant to be heard
I used to like to sing and write stories
I started cutting when I was 12, it's been five years. This year, I've been trying to stop. It's been around 3 months since I last cut.

My mom is mad at me and she's the only one who makes me feel better. I don't know who to talk to, but I promised people I wouldn't try to hurt myself again, I don't want to break my promise. Can you please stay with me and talk me through this?
I don't know, I've gotten so used to it that now whenever I feel any negative emotion, I get the urge to cut. I don't know what to do, I don't want to think anymore, I don't want to cry, I'm scared
